_comment: Reference template for Hilos configuration. Real values are stored in the 'settings' table and edited from /admin/settings. Do NOT put real secrets here — this file is committed to the repo.

admin._comment: The first user to sign up is NOT auto-admin. Create your account via /signup, then promote it manually in the database (user_roles.role = 'admin'). Use the same email/username/password you want mirrored to Pterodactyl.

smtp._comment: Used for forgotten-password emails. No Lovable reset link is used.
